senses.nuances: 输入缺少释义、原句及发音依据，不能将本项标为 official。Semira 确实可用作人名，参见署名姓名研究者的 [Semira 名称说明](https://www.babyverden.no/navn/semira/)，但这不能证明输入语料中的实际身份、词源或读音。若作人名，正文应写 Semira；顶层键与 headword.word 按要求保留 semira。以下是暂按人名设计的示例组合，不是经语料验证的高频搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Semira is documented as a personal name, but a name's history cannot establish the meaning of an unidentified corpus token. Different naming traditions may use similar spellings, and the packet supplies no sentence identifying this occurrence. Its proposed connection to mira therefore remains unverified. This entry preserves the original spelling while treating the personal-name interpretation as provisional. Source: [Semira name discussion](https://www.babyverden.no/navn/semira/).
